art_direction: 柔浅桃底，右眼低而稍宽，同向右看，温和专注地倾听。
composition_variation: Place the right eye lower and make it wider. Aim both pupils right with plenty of black mass beneath the lids. Let one lid sit marginally lower for focus, but keep the corners relaxed and gently tapered. The expression is warm attentive listening, neither skeptical nor vacant. Preserve exactly TWO eyes with the SAME iris hue, large black pupils and one slim elongated ivory glint each. Emotion comes only from the eye geometry and gaze. Use matte gouache, organic curved tapered boundaries and a visibly pale colored ground; no eyebrows, mouth, head, sclera or other marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
